notes.title: New game in development: Aquasplendere
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'd like to introduce you to:
Aquasplendere, my new game in development!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3519340/Aquasplendere/

This is a game about the management/survival of a civilisation in a world where water - the blood of Aquasplendere - is the source of all life.
You will embody the bloodline of Great Deafs who will be the leaders of this civilisation.

A demo of the game will be presented at the next Steam Neo Fest, which will take place from 9 to 16 June 2025, so add it to your wishlist!

Have a nice day or evening.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35408032/f193e5b73038910c6ce2764692fd32a0432d7377.png[/img]

notes.title: Update - 02/21/2023
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[h3]New feature: Steal gold[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35408032/5cc8de472a69a32b7b7a3f7c10e3a5094342f9df.png[/img]
You can now steal a small amount of gold from the hold to cause a "theft" event in the next watch.
This can allow you to perform a marooning/death sentence on someone you don't like.
However, make sure that there is someone who looks like you (on all three identifying characteristics) or else it will impact the crew, no matter what the punishment choice is.
In case you want to sentence someone who has the same characteristics as you, then only your human conscience will be impacted... You will have brought down an innocent person by having tarnished his image forever... It's up to you...

- Fixed a bug that did not activate the entry in the book of knowledge about injustices after having caused one during a punishment badly chosen

Have a nice day or evening.

  - Improved the captain's confidence penalty system in combat when his orders are not repeated. Confidence will be slightly less impacted but all mistakes and abuses will be punished and will make him lose patience faster

  - Fixed a wrong display of the character's name during a message after a fight about a station abandonment
  - Fixed a typo "Deackhands" instead of "Deckhands

notes.title: Since the release...
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been 6 months since the release of the game, and what an adventure!
During this time, the game has been in constant evolution. It has been sanded, patched, adjusted and made more accessible and understandable.
I would like to thank everyone who has been involved in improving A pirate quartermaster.
It is a great experience to make a video game and present it to the world. There is nothing more pleasant than to see people interested, questioned and amazed by your work.
I hope the adventure will last for a long time!

Here is a small summary of the evolution of the game since its release:

[h2]Release of the game on Linux and Mac[/h2]

[h2]Content[/h2]

- Choice of the flag flown, which has an influence on the ships encountered
- Added a gold preservation law to cover the ship's costs
- Ability to find an item in town by clicking on it
- Ability to steal goods in town when the ship is in a bad way
- Ability to meet a noble prisoner after a boarding
- Hanging event in town
- Possibility to meet characters after having lost sight of them (deserters, marooned, shipwrecked...)
- Opportunity to surrender the enemy ship before it is boarded or sunk
- Opportunity to speak well or badly behind the captain's back
- Opportunity to sell weapons to the tavern keeper
- Adding city sounds during stopovers


[h2]Ergonomics and accessibility[/h2]

- Clicking on orders simplifies interaction during naval combat
- Three difficulty modes for a tailored experience
- Bosco sheet, which allows for better control of crew tasks
- Display of sailors' statistics during events
- Reassignment of keyboard shortcuts
- Tooltips for sailor job selections
- Ability to change crew weapons from the Weapons tab
- Ability to change all sailors' battle positions from the Crew form
- More intelligent captain in general
- Added a fog indicating the exit of the fight
- Preview of the composition of the enemy ship once defeated
- Possibility to prepare before a fight (weapons, positions)

And many more bug fixes, technical, ergonomic and balancing improvements!

Thanks to all of you.

Ivan Armandy

notes.title: A pirate quartermaster is a very quirky game about pirate life - Linux version now up
notes.notes:
A pirate quartermaster from developer Ivan Armandy released back in October, and now it's available and supported directly on Linux too.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/11/a-pirate-quartermaster-is-a-very-quirky-game-about-pirate-life-linux-version-now-up

notes.title: Update - 11/25/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[h2]Today, the Linux version is available! [/h2]

[h2]Corrections[/h2]

- The ghost of the brother will no longer have a hat (will take effect in a new game)
- Added a slight colour difference to mark the arms, torso and legs of the characters

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Corrections
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

- Fixed a bug that prevented to access a stage of the slave's son quest in English language

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 11/18/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[h2]Additions[/h2]
- Addition of the possibility of finding a nobleman, prisoner on a ship during the war between peoples. This will enable two new types of objectives
- Possibility to interact with the nobleman
- New hats, the hats of the nobles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35408032/83794feafc8c12bb6994896d33df38cc2ff2df76.png[/img]

[h2]Corrections[/h2]

- Fixed a bug that would restart the main quest if you died after completing it
- A few corrections about chords to the feminine

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 11/13/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

- Fixed a bug related to the last update that prevented to leave the merchant ship meeting event sheet
- Correction of the enemy captain who continued to say "Fire" when his ship could no longer fire
- The sunken pirate ships will no longer be discoverable by pirates, this was a mistake (pirate ships sunk before this update may still cause this event, but it will have no impact
- The merchant will no longer say "Mister?" when you're an revealed woman

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Corrections
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

- Review of people's consumption of resources
- Fixed a bug where women were revealed when they were not allowed on board so during a restart
- Fixed a bug that could crash the game during a fight between two sailors
- Correction of the risk of fights when treasure-finding premiums were high (much lower)
- Correction of the chances of events when ship spotting premiums were high

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 11/11/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

- Correction of sentences where the feminine was not applied during a fight between two sailors
- Changes in the calculation of the duration of stopovers
- Remove the punishment for gambling when writing the pirate code will now improve rather than diminish the interest of the crew
- Fixed a bug that could make you leave town without a message following a theft attempt
- Fixed a bug that could prevent a sailor from being put to the well, as it was considered already in use
- Fixed a bug that could occur in the withdrawal of food and meals following a distribution

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 11/06/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

- Fixed a bug that did not remove "Contradict" and "Approve" during a theft proposition from the captain
- The information "Clicked orders are disabled during the tutorial" in the pause menu no longer overlaps the controls menu
- The captain's sentences during the tutorial will no longer be above the bottom of the right-click station menu
- Some keys made a order loop as long as it was pressed after launching a command, this is no longer the case.
- Correction of the chances of healing, which could sometimes be negative

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 11/04/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Small update today :
- Addition of a "mist" that indicates the area to which the enemy ship must go in order to flee
- Added a paper indicating the number of watches before leaving town when opening the map
- Fixed a bug that could block the game when you take a ship with a different means of locomotion
- Fixed a bug that removed the possibility of recovering water from a looted ship when removing the scuttlebutt from the plan
- The quartermaster will no longer say "I wrote in the book" during the tutorial

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Corrections
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

- Fixed a bug that could make a game crash following the vote of an objective
- Fixed a text error during the vote of an objective

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 11/02/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

- Added a shortcut that can show/hide banners behind enemies during combat phases
- During a new vote for the ship's goal, sailors will be less likely to vote for the same objective
- Fixed a bug related to the galley that could block the game because of a display of meals
- Fixed a bug that gave the wrong amount of alcohol in the booty when finding a treasure from a map
- Slight changes to the texts and areas of some personal quests for greater clarity
- Sailors with "Mad" personalities will now take away more morale when they taunt the enemies
- Shortcuts can now be changed from the pause menu
- Fixed a bug that blocked the sickbay station if a sailor died this watch
- In English, replacement of the word dish by meal

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 11/01/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[h2]Additions[/h2]
- Added the possibility to reassign the shortcuts
- Display of a background improving visibility when right-clicking on a sailor to assign him to a station
- Possibility to find an object by searching in town
- New sentence from the innkeeper on this subject
- From now on, during emergency situations, when you arrive in town, if the hull is very damaged and you have no wood, or the sails/machines are very damaged and you have nothing to repair them with, if the town does not sell anything you ask for, the captain may propose to steal resources, exposing you to risks but allowing you to recover a particular resource

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35408032/c218643a2963970d93d327d560132967523d69ca.jpg[/img]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
- Revisions of the orders given by the captain, they will be a little more logical and depending on the personality of the captain may change slightly
- From now on, enlisting a sailor in town will remove 1 inhabitant
- The quartermaster will no longer pronounce "I wrote in the book" during ration/pay distributions

[h2]Corrections[/h2]
- Fixed a bug that prevented switching from one sailor's sheet to another when one of them was solving a problem with the captain
- Fixed a bug that displayed the sailors solving a problem with the captain in the boatswain's sheet
- Correction of the display of an information sheet of a city that could be cut off from the top of the screen
- Fixed a bug that didn't heal wounds well during a special event
- Correction of a morale withdrawal during a premature departure caused by the captain which was not correctly applied
- Fixed a bug that put the wrong amount in the loot when a treasure was found
- Fixed a bug related to the discovery of a wreck which could display empty interface
- Fixed a bug of sick sailors who were blocking a station in town
- Fixed a bug that disrupted the prostitute's daughter's quest when the ship sank out of combat

Have a nice Sunday!

notes.title: Update - 10/25/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

- The captain will be less crazy and will attack military ships less
- The captain will be less crazy and will attack less if the crew is very small
- Fixed a bug that caused sailboats to carry metal instead of fabric
- Correction of the message that indicated that the butcher's son had to collect 1500 gold instead of 2000
- Sailors repairing the rigging will now be in front of the capstan for better visibility

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 10/24/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

- Reduced the risk of sailors causing trouble
- Fixed a bug that could block the game after a loot sharing, an enlistment... 
- Fixed a bug that could prevent the repair of sails/machines when they were completely broken
- Correction of overlapping injustice dialogs
- The controls in the pause menu were shifted
- Correction of a bug that occurred if there was no captain in town

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 10/22/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Assignment of stations:
- From now on, when a boatswain is elected, you have access to a list of the current crew whose you can modify the stations more easily
- New entry on this subject in the book of knowledge
- Addition of a hotkey for the Boatswain's sheet
- When you click on a sailor to assign him to a position, a list of his specialties will be displayed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35408032/5f36837ae2db1da221aa3da0726a5fb25a6cff9e.jpg[/img]

Law for ship's costs:
- Addition of a law which allows to preserve a part of the booty for the eventual costs of the ship
- Reduction of the levels of impact on morale of the height of the shares

Modifications:
- Quantities of goods at the beginning of a ship increased for all levels of difficulty
- Number of guns at the beginning of a ship fixed and increased in easy and normal, except for the tutorial
- Rebalancing the quantities of gold of the ship encountered during the tutorial and the ships encountered related to the story
- Enemy guns now do less damage in easy mode
- Less chances that the captain want to attack if the ship is out of guns or cannonballs
- GET DOWN is no longer pronounced by the enemy captain if you don't have guns on that side
- Adding character info during events in difficult mode
- Reduction of the bonus linked to the charisma of the quartermaster if an injustice is done
- "I wrote in the book" is no longer displayed on the map
- Removing the cross from the pirate code present at the time of the recruit's enlistment
- Addition of arrows on the character sheet to go from one sheet to another without the hotkeys
- Now, in case of a contradiction for a treasure map, you will have to double click to note down a position and not just a single click to avoid accidents
- Fixed a bug that considered actives some seriously ill sailors
- Rats will appear a little less easily
- From now on, in the organization sheet, if there are rats in the ship, it will be written down

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 10/17/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

EDIT: Addition of the possibility for the captain to resign, thus not leaving the crew

- Adding the number of people in the crew on the rations sheet (easy mode)
- Reduced risk of destruction of the guns during early reloading (easy mode)
- Tooltips next to station assignments (easy and normal modes)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35408032/b4379d69607ff5aca8cf06484ed912793469cbea.jpg[/img]

- Adding the quantity of fabric/metal/wood to repair a percentage of sail/machinery/hull durability to the book of knowledge
- The QM will now say when he has a new entry in his book
- The sentences of the merchant who refused to deal with you because there were still goods in transit were revised
- The FIRE and RELOAD orders will follow each other less quickly (which disturbed the new players, rushing to type the orders when the gunners were not ready)
- Withdrawal of time to accomplish the objective, from now on the sailors will become impatient according to several parameters, especially morale, and will ask for a change of objective after a certain time, if it is not accomplished.
[u]There will surely be a problem with the current objective at the time of the update, but from the next goal on, it will work fine.[/u]
- Impact of successful and unsuccessful targets recalculated
- Fixed a variable that could more easily provoke mutinies 
- Adjusted buttons for selecting characters in a captain's election
- Changing from 30 to 24 crew members for the success: "A real community"

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 10/15/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Small update :

- Fixed a bug that blocked the design of shovels for locomotion
- Less chance of sailors voting for the city if the holds are not very full
- Progressive evolution of the NPCs' strength spread over a longer period of watches
- Fixed a bug that could appear during a battle following a dispute with a merchant
- Some text corrections

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 10/14/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

- Fixed a bug that could condemn you to stay in town
- Fixed a bug that did not update immediately if the ship has a doctor
- Fixed a bug that could occur when seizing a ship without a galley when you had one
- Fixed a bug that did not display the pieces of map obtained when displaying the quartermaster's sheet
- Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash when a ship was detected
- Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash after an insufficient number of hammocks
- The impact on the speed of the machines by the machinists will now be well enforced

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 10/13/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today's update :

Additions and revisions:
- The time to achieve the goal has been revised. From now on, you will have to negotiate with the captain not a time to achieve an objective but rather a time to focus on an objective.
The shorter the duration, the more morale will be impacted in case of success or failure.
This will also give you more opportunity to change objectives if the current one is far away. If a pirate is able to adapt, then a captain and a quartermaster even more!
- The interval before a sailor can get sick again is now longer
- Chances of recovery for seriously ill patients when a sailor is assigned to enhanced care
- Rebalancing of the distribution of gold from cities to ships sent
- If the relationship with the people is "Privileged", then the merchant will be there every watch
- The AI will be less fooled if you close your sails or cut your machines
- Possibility of surprise after the surrender of an enemy
- The "s" of the projectiles orders have been removed, they will now be in the singular
- A few sentences have been rewritten
- Some balancing

Bugs :
- Fixed game endings that were incorrectly displayed
- Fixed a bug that prevented to shoot and reload when you had the "(at will)"
- Fixed a bug that allowed to click on the characters while a menu was open

If you have any bugs or quirks, don't hesitate to tell me!

Have a nice day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 10/12/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Update :

- Fixed  a bug related to the election of an officer, the arguments were not well counted
- Fixed a bug following an altercation with a merchant in town that caused the following fight to bug
- Fixed a bug that incorrectly detected a doctor on the ship
- The flag of a people with whom one has a "To kill" relationship will no longer be proposed by the captain
- Actions with people will change the relationship more quickly negatively if you have a positive relationship and more quickly positively if you have a negative relationship

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 10/11-2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Bug corrections :
- Fixed a bug in the display of possible thieves
- Enemy boarding strength decreased for all difficulties
- Fixed a bug related to the acquisition of clothes by sailors which could cause a crash at the end of a boarding
- Fixed a bug related to the lookout that prevented the captain from wanting to attack ships

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Error corrected
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I made a change in an update a few days ago that greatly increased the risk of losing sailors to enemy cannon fire.
I corrected it in yesterday's update.

Sorry for the mistake.

Good game.

notes.title: Update - 10/10/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Update :

- More chances to meet a ship when the last encounter is a long time ago, chances adapted to the difficulty of the game
- Review of the captain's opinion on whether or not to attack a ship
- From now on, the higher the charisma of the quartermaster, the more it increases the morale of the sailor with whom he has been discussing and reduces the negative impact of injustices and punishments that do not follow the law
- Statistics and characteristics now displayed during events involving a sailor, except in difficult mode
- Added an additional contradiction for the understanding of the tutorial
- Added description of the game in Chinese on the shop page
- Added the possibility to navigate between the sailors' sheets with the PageUp/PageDown keys

Bugs :
- Weapons are still maintained after the surrender of an enemy ship
- Fixed a bug about the accounting of hammocks when modifying the compartments
- Fixed a bug about the speed after the capture of an enemy ship that surrendered

Good day or evening.

notes.title: Update - 10/07/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today's bigger update :

- Reorganization of elements on the creation page
Three difficulty levels :
Easy, normal and difficult (selectable when creating the character)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35408032/951a8a9c3af1b3d0f65c37fa817949b0f914a03b.jpg[/img]

Use of the pavilions :
    - Every night, the captain will propose to fly a flag that will have an impact on ship encounters, unless you have a rebellious captain who doesn't give a damn about these things
    - New entry on this subject in the book of knowledge

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35408032/04940d110e5f5b4c367abff584b09a0f5ee16074.jpg[/img]

- Clarification added on the disabling of clicking on orders during the tutorial
- Possibility of provoking the surrender of a ship before sinking or boarding her
- If the enlisted sailors or slaves start with their morale high, this will not be the case for sailors enlisted after a boarding

Bugs :
- Fixed a bug related to the distribution of rations, because of injustices
- Fixed bugs during the tutorial related to the pause menu
- Fixed a bug related to gybing after the enemy ship has passed over another sea level

Have a nice day or evening!

notes.title: Update - 10/06/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Small update :
- From now on, the ship will start with maximum morale, and each new sailor enlisted as well
- Modification of keys, be careful!
- Possibility from now on to move the zoomed screen thanks to the arrows or to WASD or ZQSD.
- Correction of a bug that doubled the tutorial texts during boarding

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A new update :
- Fixed a bug that reactivated the machines that were shut down by themselves in combat
- Fixed a bug that blocked the access to battle stations to the guns after gybing
- Fixed a bug where crews were falling at the start/during a boarding due to bad click detection
- Fixed a bug that overlapped fights and menu displays
- Added black borders for very wide resolutions
- Colour of the displayed orders adapted to the time of day in order to see them better
- Some text corrections

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Small update :
- Correction of a bug related to the death of a character
- Improvement of collisions when moving and creating the map
- Improvement of the mouseover of the characters when selecting them
- Revision of disease evolution

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A small update:

- Correction of a bug related to the music volume slider

- Added the functionality to pronounce orders with the mouse click, which can be activated from the character's choice screen and/or from the pause menu.This doesn't remove the possibility to type orders on the keyboard, and can therefore allow to type some of them and to pronounce others from the list with the click of the mouse.

Also added to the demo

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Update of the demo
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

New update of the demo :
  - Added a panel displaying the combat statistics of the characters in the Weapons menu
  - Added a panel displaying sailors' specialties in the Crew menu
  - Display of the battle stations assigned to the sailors in the Crew menu
  - Added the possibility to change the sailors battle stations from the Crew menu.
  - Fixed a bug related to the location of cities on the map
  - Various parameter adjustments
  - Various translation corrections and other bugs

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Update of the demo
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

An update of the demo has been made, with some additions and some bug fixes.

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Announcement of the game's release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The game A pirate quartermaster will be released on Friday, 2 October 2020.

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Steam's Summer Game Festival
notes.notes:
Hi!

The game A pirate quartermaster will participate in the festival which will take place from June 9 ot 14, 2020!
Throughout this festival, you will have access to a demo of the game in order to have a taste of it!

Have a nice day!

notes.title: The game will be released in 2020
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Having been a little pretentious about the progress of the game development, I inform you that it will be delayed. I can't be specific about how long it will take, but I think the game will be ready in the first quarter of 2020.

Have a good day!
